Guideline Title: Guideline 1 – Outsourcing of critical or important functions

Generalized Compliance Audit.SoG Requirement: Guideline 1 – Outsourcing of critical or important functions

Detailed Compliance Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.1. The undertaking should establish a written outsourcing policy that is approved by the administrative, management or supervisory body.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Reference: Policy A > Governance and approval > line 30-31
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Excerpt: This Policy is approved by the Board of Directors and is reviewed at least annually.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Compliance Audit Note: A written outsourcing policy exists and is approved by the Board of Directors, which is the governing body.

Detailed Compliance Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.2. Before outsourcing a critical or important function, the undertaking should perform a documented due diligence on the service provider.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Reference: Policy B > Due diligence > line 27-28; Policy A > Critical or important functions > line 46-47
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Excerpt: A documented due diligence assessment must be completed before any contract for a critical or important function is signed. ... The business owner documents the criticality assessment before the selection of a service provider starts
Detailed Compliance Audit.Compliance Audit Note: Mandatory language ('must be completed before') covers the timing and the documentation of the due diligence.

Detailed Compliance Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.3. The written agreement should grant the undertaking and its supervisory authority effective access to all data and premises of the service provider that relate to the outsourced function.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Excerpt: The agreement must grant the Company the right to audit the service provider's data related to the outsourced function.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Compliance Audit Note: Access to data is granted to the Company only. Access for the supervisory authority and access to premises are not mentioned.

Detailed Compliance Audit.SoG Requirement: 1.4. The undertaking should maintain an exit plan for each critical outsourcing arrangement and test it at least every two years.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Reference: Policy A > Termination and exit > line 83-84
Detailed Compliance Audit.Policy Excerpt: An exit plan may be prepared for critical outsourcing arrangements where the business owner considers it necessary.
Detailed Compliance Audit.Compliance Audit Note: Permissive language ('may be prepared') is used and no testing of exit plans is required.

Compliance Audit Summary: The SoG is partially compliant. Relevant regulatory requirements are addressed in Outsourcing Policy, Governance and approval and Written agreement, and in Third-Party Risk Standard, Due diligence. But supervisory access, access to premises and mandatory, tested exit plans are missing.
